content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and it's very doable to change. Start with a small step tonight. Do a short bedtime routine in his own bed, then stay in the room, sitting on a chair next to him, until he falls asleep. Once that feels normal, move the chair a little farther from the bed every few nights. Tell him the plan in the daytime, so it isn't a surprise at bedtime.
